title: Combustion Engineer
description:
As a Combustion Engineer at Honeywell, in the Midlands, you will be responsible for performing equipment start-ups, commissioning, and scheduled maintenance activities at customer sites along with diagnosing and resolving technical issues through effective problem-solving and troubleshooting. This is a field-based role, with travel across the region and the UK as required with overnight stays.

Honeywell Industrial Automation enables our customers to run safer and more efficient operations. From refineries to distribution centers to retail stores, we help deliver results while improving worker safety and meeting sustainability goals such as reduced carbon emissions – by leveraging connectivity, advanced data analytics, software, robotics, sensors, process automation and asset performance management solutions.

We Enable our Customers to Enhance the Safety, Sustainability, Resilience and Productivity of their People, Plants, and Assets.

Key responsibilities

  • Supporting engineering activities to achieve on-site installation, commissioning, servicing and repair processes of complex equipment and systems, working independently at times.
  • Prepare site visit reports for audit and compliance.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives in the processes related to field services and product development.
  • Support cross-functional groups to quickly fix any administrative difficulties relating to delivery and installation of proper equipment.
  • Ensure that the Company Health and Safety Policy is adhered to, actively promoting a safe working environment.

Key skills and qualifications

  • Previous combustion engineering experience working with process gas and oil burners or similar environments
  • Good knowledge of mechanical systems including industrial or commercial installation experience (plumbing, pipework, hydraulics)
  • Ability to read and understand P&IDs, and electrical schematics.
  • Commercial Gas certification (COCN1, TPCP1, CCN1, CIGA1, CORT1 & CDGA1, ICPN1)
  • Able to work confidently on their own initiative as well as a part of a team.

Our offer

  • A culture that fosters inclusion, diversity and innovation
  • Commercial/industrial gas safe certification training and development offered
